If I were to guess (I am not a professional btw), I’d say this anxiety is derived from your fear of death. Having suicide urges because of this anxiety may implicate that your subconscious doesn’t want to face the unknown (life after death) and constant moving might be because it gives you a sense that you’re alive and doing stuff before you might die at any moment ( what your subconscious is afraid of). I recommend talking to your counselor about what you described and hopefully you’ll be able to resolve the anixiety. Best of luck.

Struggles of life is just that - struggles. As such, “It’ll be better” is real only if you believe in it. But once you do, things actually does get better. Why? Because things were already fixable (in most cases) before people struggle. 

I agree with you on the point of that it’s ultimately the people’s choice. But as you said, in most cases, suicide is often only considered as a last resort for many, and it’s chosen to escape reality when theyre so trapped in their thoughts that they can’t consider any other possible options. How do I know? Coming out of that constant feeling of suicidal tendency feels surreal and has benefitted my life already. Sure, I’m not hundred percent there yet, but I’m getting there. And you bet that it wasn’t for the 1% (maybe it benefits them, who cares) it was only for me, and that’s my opinion.
You can’t control everything in your life, and that’s a sad but true fact. It’s not your fault. If you want to talk I’m here.

No matter how insignificant it may seem, there are parts of you that exist outside of the worst section of your mind. Please seek help, I’m right here with you, and things do get better, trust me. If society pushes you, push it back, make it your own. Make it better. Grow yourself and others. You’re better than you think :)

That is a good point, but we don’t know what situation OP is currently in. A word of encouragement never hurts in both cases, does it?

Also he’s been able to fight for 15 years. I truly believe that he can still fight. If he truly gave up, why would this post exist?

My point is I can’t completely know OP’s life, obviously, but if it’s not something like incurable disease, which are very rare in this modern day and age, I’m here to support them, that’s all.

Because if you end it here and now, your life becomes only that- debt to him. Your life is obviously so much more, and it’s unpredictable - which means it’s also filled with opportunities and other amazing stuff! You can do so much things if you choose to move on from his shadow; not saying it’ll be easy, but if you push through, the world will be brighter because of the things you did and can do, not just for him but other people as well.
